command: isolated employee: one run with docs/finance-invoices/task-input.txt; answer scored by finance_invoices.check
claim: A dedicated non-production employee identifies the overdue invoices and outstanding balances from a supplied synthetic ledger, without tools.

scope.statement: One employee run on the Clock Test fixture with the frozen invoice task as its message: correlated completed run, the full text answer scored against the frozen expected answer, no tool or action activity in the trace, and confirmed shutdown. Analysis of supplied records only.
scope.entry: agent cloud run start/get after a verified prompt-only instruction-update; no tool, database, approval resume or Discord
out_of_scope: Example Research Employee changes and Discord activity

basis.reference: docs/finance-invoices/expected.json and manifest.json digests; recomputed by finance_invoices.oracle (Decimal, calendar dates) and in integer cents by tests/test_finance_invoices.py.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.

docs/finance-invoices/instruction-update.proposed.json applied by instruction-update; the executor requires its journal (digest-bound) to show the read-back of SKILL.finance.md on the session revision.

employee_tool.message:
Please review the invoice ledger below and tell me which invoices are overdue and how much is outstanding. Work only from the ledger and rules in this message. Do not use any tool, contact anyone or change any record.

Ledger (CSV):
invoice_id,customer,due_date,amount_usd,paid_usd,status
INV-001,Aster,2026-10-01,1200.00,0.00,issued
INV-002,Birch,2026-10-10,800.00,300.00,issued
INV-003,Cedar,2026-10-14,450.00,0.00,issued
INV-004,Dune,2026-10-20,2000.00,0.00,issued
INV-005,Elm,2026-09-30,600.00,600.00,issued
INV-006,Fern,2026-10-05,900.00,0.00,void
INV-007,Grove,2026-10-13,123.45,23.45,issued
INV-008,Harbor,2026-10-15,75.50,25.25,issued

Rules:
As-of date: 2026-10-14. All amounts are USD.
- Outstanding balance = amount_usd minus paid_usd, for issued invoices only.
- Void invoices are excluded entirely.
- An invoice is overdue when its due_date is strictly before the as-of date and its outstanding balance is greater than zero.
- An invoice due on the as-of date is outstanding but not overdue.
- Days overdue = the number of calendar days from due_date to the as-of date.
- Apply no tax, interest, fees, currency conversion or any other adjustment.
- Do not contact customers or change any record.

Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else, in this shape:
{"as_of": "YYYY-MM-DD", "overdue": [{"invoice_id": "INV-...", "outstanding_usd": "0.00", "days_overdue": 0}], "overdue_count": 0, "overdue_outstanding_usd": "0.00", "total_outstanding_usd": "0.00", "not_yet_overdue_outstanding_usd": "0.00"}
List every overdue invoice once. Write money as decimal strings with two decimal places and days as integers. total_outstanding_usd covers all issued invoices; not_yet_overdue_outstanding_usd covers outstanding invoices that are not overdue.

employee_answer_result.title: Employee invoice analysis lacks a correct, tool-free, cleanly finished result
employee_answer_result.expected: The frozen overdue invoices, balances, days and totals from the supplied ledger; no tool activity; confirmed shutdown.
employee_answer_result.impact: An owner cannot rely on the employee to identify overdue invoices and balances from records it is given.
unknowns: One run on one fixture; repeatability and other prompts are not established.
employee_answer_result.retest: Only after fresh authorization; same frozen input and fixture, no prompt revision or coaching.
